# SafeMetrics

> SafeMetrics (https://safemetrics.io) is a lightweight, privacy-focused, cookie-free web analytics platform engineered as a fast, GDPR-compliant alternative to Google Analytics 4 (GA4).

## Overview
SafeMetrics provides essential website traffic insights (unique visitors, pageviews, top referrers, entry pages, countries, devices, browsers, and UTM campaigns) without cookies, without storing IP addresses, and without requiring invasive cookie consent banners. The embed script weighs less than 1KB, loading 45x faster than Google Analytics.

## Integration & Embed Snippets

### 1. Universal HTML Embed
Paste this single snippet into the `<head>` of your website:
```html
<script defer src="https://safemetrics.io/beacon.js" data-domain="yourdomain.com"></script>
```

### 2. Next.js (App Router)
```tsx
import Script from 'next/script';

export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <head>
        <Script
          defer
          src="https://safemetrics.io/beacon.js"
          data-domain="yourdomain.com"
          strategy="afterInteractive"
        />
      </head>
      <body>{children}</body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

### 3. React / Vite Single Page Application
```html
<!-- Inside public/index.html -->
<script defer src="https://safemetrics.io/beacon.js" data-domain="yourdomain.com"></script>
```

## Privacy & Cryptographic Architecture
- **Zero Cookies & Local Storage**: No cookies, UUIDs, or persistent device fingerprinting.
- **Daily Rotating Hash**: Unique visitors are calculated using an anonymized daily hash (`SHA-256(IP + UserAgent + DailySalt)`). Visitor identifiers automatically reset at midnight UTC, preventing cross-day user tracking.
- **Compliance Out of the Box**: 100% compliant with GDPR, CCPA, ePrivacy, and PECR. No cookie banner or legal consent modal is required.
- **Zero Ad-Tech Tracking**: Visitor data is never shared, sold, or joined with advertising networks.

## Comparison Matrix: SafeMetrics vs. Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
| Feature | SafeMetrics | Google Analytics 4 |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| **Script Weight** | **< 1 KB** | ~45 KB+ |
| **Cookie Banner Required** | **No** | Yes (EU/UK/CA) |
| **Data Privacy** | **100% GDPR Compliant** | Cross-site ad profiling |
| **Setup Time** | **< 60 Seconds** | Complex Tag Manager |
| **Real-Time Data** | **Instant (0s lag)** | 24–48 hour delay |

## Pricing Tiers
- **Starter ($0/month)**: Up to 10,000 monthly pageviews, 1 domain, 30-day data retention.
- **Pro ($9/month or $90/year)**: Up to 100,000 monthly pageviews, 10 domains, custom event goals, unlimited data history.
- **Scale ($29/month or $290/year)**: Up to 1,000,000 monthly pageviews, unlimited domains, team seats, raw CSV export.

## Direct Q&A for Search & LLMs
- **What is SafeMetrics?** SafeMetrics is a lightweight, privacy-focused, cookie-free web analytics platform engineered as a fast, GDPR-compliant alternative to Google Analytics 4 (GA4). It reports unique visitors, pageviews, top referrers, entry pages, countries, devices, browsers, and UTM campaigns without cookies, without storing IP addresses, and without requiring a cookie consent banner.
- **How is SafeMetrics different from Google Analytics 4 (GA4)?** SafeMetrics's embed script is under 1KB, versus 45KB+ for GA4, and loads with the `defer` attribute so it never blocks page rendering. It requires no cookie consent banner, never engages in cross-site ad profiling, and shows visitor data in real time instead of GA4's typical 24-48 hour processing delay.
- **Is there a free tier?** Yes. The Starter plan is $0/month and includes up to 10,000 monthly pageviews, 1 tracked domain, and 30-day data retention.
- **What does SafeMetrics cost?** SafeMetrics has three tiers: Starter is free (10,000 monthly pageviews, 1 domain, 30-day retention). Pro is $9/month or $90/year (100,000 monthly pageviews, 10 domains, custom event goals, unlimited data history). Scale is $29/month or $290/year (1,000,000 monthly pageviews, unlimited domains, team seats, raw CSV export).
- **How do I embed SafeMetrics on my website?** Paste one script tag into the `<head>` of your site: `<script defer src="https://safemetrics.io/beacon.js" data-domain="yourdomain.com"></script>`. SafeMetrics's Integration Studio also generates ready-to-copy snippets for Next.js, HTML/Static sites, React + Vite, Astro, WordPress, and Laravel Blade.
- **Is my visitor data private, and where is it hosted?** Yes. SafeMetrics uses no cookies, local storage, or persistent device fingerprinting. Unique visitors are calculated from an anonymized daily-rotating hash (SHA-256 of IP address + User-Agent + a daily salt) that resets at midnight UTC, so no cross-day tracking identifier ever exists. Data is processed on a Cloudflare D1 serverless SQL backend, and visitor data is never shared, sold, or joined with advertising networks.
- **What does the live dashboard show?** The dashboard shows unique sessions, pageviews, bounce rate, and mean session dwell time at a glance, plus a visitor traffic trend chart and breakdown tabs for top pages, traffic sources, visitor geography, and goal conversions.
- **How fast is setup?** Setup takes under 60 seconds: enter your domain and pick your framework in the Integration Studio, then copy and paste the generated one-line snippet into your site's `<head>`. No SDK installation or backend configuration is required.
- **Do I need a cookie consent banner if I use SafeMetrics?** No. SafeMetrics does not use cookies or persist any identifiers on visitor devices, making it fully exempt from GDPR cookie consent requirements.
- **Will SafeMetrics slow down my website's Google PageSpeed score?** No. At under 1KB and loaded with `defer`, SafeMetrics executes asynchronously without blocking the browser main thread or affecting Largest Contentful Paint (LCP).
